description: Create a wrapper for list-type responses that preserves raw response data during batch extractions. When processing responses where the response model is List[Model] or Iterable[Model], ensure the raw response attribute is properly maintained to prevent AttributeErrors.
functional_requirements: Create a ListResponse class that subclasses list and includes a _raw_response attribute
Modify response processing logic to detect list/iterable response models and wrap outputs in ListResponse
Ensure the wrapper preserves all list functionality while carrying the raw response data through the pipeline
Update both synchronous and asynchronous response processing paths to handle list-type responses consistently
Add comprehensive tests for batch extractions with List[Model] response types
